snippet.title: Froggy Hates Snow | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door — or defeat the final boss to survive.
